15233:     /**
15234:      * Fired when a renderer-initiated navigation is requested.
15235: Navigation may still be cancelled after the event is issued.
15236:      */
15237:     export type frameRequestedNavigationPayload = {
15238:       /**
15239:        * Id of the frame that is being navigated.
15240:        */
15241:       frameId: FrameId;
15242:       /**
15243:        * The reason for the navigation.
15244:        */
15245:       reason: ClientNavigationReason;
15246:       /**
15247:        * The destination URL for the requested navigation.
15248:        */
15249:       url: string;
15250:       /**
15251:        * The disposition for the navigation.
15252:        */
15253:       disposition: ClientNavigationDisposition;
15254:     }
